verdict.rationale: Supabase offers strong AI-native tooling: an official MCP server (verified live, auth-gated) and CLI (verified headless install/init), OpenAPI spec, and auto-generated type-safe REST/GraphQL APIs, all well-suited for programmatic/agentic use. However, community evidence flags real security caveats—prompt-injection risks and MCP running with elevated service_role access bypassing RLS—suggesting the AI-native tooling works but with meaningful trust/safety gaps.
